DECISION: Remove LLM-generated focus titles from Pixel Office UserPromptSubmit hook
OPTIONS: 
  1. claude -p haiku call per user prompt (tried) — 17% token budget consumed per session
  2. Pure heuristic extraction from UserPromptSubmit hook payload
REASONING: 17% per session is unsustainable for a passive background tool. Ned explicitly said 'remove all the functionality of this, use heuristics'
REVISIT WHEN: Anthropic API key is available (direct API ~1-2s, ~$0.001/call vs session token budget impact)
CURRENT STATE: UserPromptSubmit hook removed from settings.json, /api/hooks/user-prompt being simplified to pure heuristic extraction (first meaningful line of prompt, stripped of markdown/noise)
